name.baseName: Environmental Product Declaration for Photovoltaic Modules

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: The photovoltaic (PV) modules are mainly made by a lamination of PV cells, front glass, encapsulation, interconnection and busbar string, junction box and Aluminum frame are adhered to the lamination. the manufacturing flow process is cell loading, half-cutting, soldering, layup, framing, solidification & clean and final test & packaging.
technology.technologicalApplicability: The PV modules are used to convert light into electricity.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.useAdviceForDataSet: LCA results of the product(s) - main environmental performance results based on the worst-case scenario. The system boundary considered in this LCA study is “cradle to gate with options, modules C1-C4, module D with optional modules (A1–A3 + A4 + A5 + C + D)”. A1-A3: Product stage (raw material acquisition, transport to manufacturing site and manufacturing) A4: Transport to user site A5: Installation C1-C4: End-of-life stage (deconstruction, transport, waste processing and disposal) D: Reuse, recovery and/or recycling potentials
